Smith, A.R. and Klosek, J. (2001). A review of air separation technologies and their integration with energy conversion processes. Fuel Processing Technology 70(2), 115-134. https://doi.org/10.1016/S0378-3820(01)00131-X

Locators are printed journal page numbers 115-134 (PDF page = printed - 114). Authors from Air Products (US). A qualitative review: the only energy numbers are one worked example (Sect. 6.1) of an 890 sTPD, 500 psig oxygen supply for a 5000-bpd GTL plant - cryogenic full pumped-LOX cycle about 12.5 MW and a pressure-swing chemical ASU about 10.5 MW, converted to kWh per metric t oxygen with an explicit formula (short ton = 0.907185 t); steam use in _flows. Table 1 status, economic range (sTPD) and purity limits are loaded as state-of-development and capacity rows for cryogenic, adsorption, membrane, chemical and ITM. No kWh/t by technology or purity is printed for adsorption, membrane or ITM, and no costs are printed. Not extracted: integration concepts (Sect. 5-6, qualitative), figures (no printed values).
